mechanics.claim: The charged recast deals 100% increased damage compared to the uncharged recast.
mechanics.quote: it deals 100% increased damage and enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not start until after the recast/effect resolves, not on initial cast.
If no enemies are hit in front of Poppy on the charged recast, she instead fires a shockwave that erupts on hitting a champion, dealing the charged effects to that target and nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: she sends a shockwave that travels in the target direction until it collides with an enemy champion, which causes a hammer to erupt. Targets hit by the shockwave or the eruption receive the charged effects.

mechanics.claim: Certain item passives (Experimental Hexplate, Fiendhunter Bolts, Zeke's Convergence) activate 0.2 seconds into the recast's cast time, and do not trigger if the channel is interrupted or times out.
mechanics.quote: activate after {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time of ''Keeper's Verdict's'' recast. They do not activate if the first cast's channel is interrupted or times out.

mechanics.claim: Keeper's Verdict can be blocked by spell shields.
